name: חֵזִיר
summary: David’s seventeenth priestly division is allotted to Hezir. Another Hezir appears among those who seal the covenant in Nehemiah.

evidence.note: Hezir stands between Meshullam and Meshezabel in the Hebrew list.

note: The name resembles חֲזִיר, the boar of Ps 80:14. The first vowel differs, and the proposed name sense rests on the form alone. TIPNR uses English verse numbering for the Nehemiah key.
